# GuideLink v0.1.3

GuideLink's profile form now groups everyday settings together, explains each
option and keeps detailed tuning options collapsed. Sync and availability checks
also avoid repeated preparation, database reads and unchanged writes.

## Clearer configuration

- Profiles are organised into **Profile details**, **Lineup & programme guide**,
  **Channel handling**, and **Backups & stream health**.
- Download settings, matching thresholds, ordering, primary-stream selection and
  stream-check details start collapsed. Closing a section does not disable its
  settings or reset saved values.
- **Disable channels without a confirmed match** describes the existing cleanup
  policy. **Enable newly imported live channels** sits alongside it. The v0.1.2
  defaults and saved choices are unchanged.
- Playlist assignments, shared aliases, schedules and alerts have clearer names
  and help text. Download-service keys are masked with a reveal button; their
  storage is unchanged.

With the accompanying [m3u-editor form update](https://github.com/m3ue/m3u-editor/pull/1655),
fields follow the selected source, API keys appear only when needed, and checker
controls appear only for GuideLink-managed checkers. Hidden fields retain their
values. That host update also reduces repeated form-loading work.

The host update is optional and was still awaiting merge when this release was
prepared. On the current upstream host, all fields remain visible and the new
labels, help text, grouping and plugin runtime improvements still apply.

## Less repeated work

- Reuse validated source preparation, guide mappings, aliases and matching
  indexes when their inputs are unchanged within an action. Current ownership,
  guide data and alias selections are still checked before reuse.
- Batch alias and guide lookups, deduplicate backup coverage and avoid loading
  unused channel columns or repeatedly inspecting the stream-checker schema.
- Reuse native-setting plans and channel-change summaries, and avoid rewriting
  unchanged playlist settings. Concurrent-edit checks, cancellation, quarantine
  ownership and transactional result replacement remain covered by regressions.
- Add a maintainer walkthrough covering sync order, partial commits, data shapes
  and cache lifetimes to make future changes easier to review and support.

## Upgrade

Install the attached `guidelink.zip` through the reviewed plugin update flow.
Pause GuideLink triggers and let active runs finish before updating, then recycle
Horizon workers and reload web PHP workers where OPcache requires it. Follow the
[upgrade guide](https://github.com/djrarky/GuideLink/blob/v0.1.3/docs/INSTALL.md#update-an-existing-install).

Profiles, playlist assignments and aliases are preserved; no settings migration
or new plugin database schema is required. Saving a profile does not sync a
playlist. Use **Preview Sync** to inspect the saved configuration before applying
it or resuming scheduled apply runs.

## Validation

- Current upstream host `7ce0d553d`: **226 tests / 1,528 assertions** passed on
  PostgreSQL 16; three tests for optional, unmerged host APIs were skipped.
- Host PR #1655 at `b3e94635f`: **229 tests / 1,556 assertions** passed on SQLite,
  including conditional fields and preserved hidden values. The revised form and
  scrubber query-count tests also passed on PostgreSQL.
- All **112 PHP files** passed syntax and formatting checks. The standalone
  validator and all **nine release-tool tests** passed.
- The packaged **0.1.2 → 0.1.3 upgrade** passed reviewed installation, trust and
  integrity checks while preserving a saved profile and playlist assignment.
  The isolated install test used the host's fake scanner, not a malware scan.

Form interactions are exercised through Livewire integration tests. Fresh live
scraping, production load benchmarks and a manual browser walkthrough were not
part of this release validation.

Download `guidelink.zip` for installation. `SHA256SUMS` verifies the assets and
`release.json` records the hash of each packaged file.
